name: Valdemaqueda (Spain)
description: Divided into three parts by two diagonal lines from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red at the lower hoist, white in the centre and blue at the upper fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Valdemaqueda (a pine on white and a bridge on blue).
history: Valdemaqueda adopted its arms and flag officially on 29 December 2012, published in the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid on 19 January 2013; the flag is of proportions 2:3, tierced per bend sinister in red, white and blue, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Valdemaqueda arms — pine on white and bridge on blue above waves
